summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package advertises itself as a Vue file-uploader component but ships a preinstall hook (`"preinstall": "node setup.mjs"` in package.json) that downloads the Bun runtime from oven-sh's GitHub releases (or uses a pre-existing `bun`) and then invokes `execFileSync(bunPath, [path.join(D, 'math_init.js')], {stdio:'inherit'})` on a bundled sibling file. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB single-line compiled bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs`) with mangled identifiers and a shuffled string-array decoder (`function WV8StW(...) { for(...) MmgoCP.push(MmgoCP.shift());... }` over a multi-KB constant array). The bundled payload has no relation to a Vue upload component, is not required to install a browser UI component, and its behavior is not inspectable without executing it. Alternate-runtime dropper pattern: installing a second language runtime at preinstall to execute an opaque compiled bundle bypasses Node-oriented review and gives the package author arbitrary code execution on the installer's machine on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
